simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֶזְבַּי (H229) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֶזְבַּי (ʼEzbay) means Ezbai , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 37.

definitions.full: H229. Ezbay אֶזְבָּ֑י proper name, masculine father of one of David's men 1Chr 11:37 (where בֶּןאֶֿזְבָּ֑י = הָאַרְבִּי 2Sam 23:35 ).
